assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints from the repository.
assumptions.impact: All area, ratio, node, and project-location outputs must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace site_boundary/key_areas, regenerate all dependent geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage, fire, utilities, and engineering constraints are missing.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, retain-renovate-demolish, and engineering decisions remain unknown or conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Existing water supply, drainage, reclaimed-water, flood-control, water-quality, and underground utility data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No pipe diameter, detention volume, potable-water point, drainage capacity, outfall, or flood-protection claim is made.

assumptions.statement: The six gates and twelve station points express network relationships rather than surveyed installation sites.
assumptions.impact: Every point requires accessibility, safety, ownership, microclimate, ponding, and operations verification before use.

assumptions.statement: AI services remain advisory and reversible; critical municipal control and public-safety decisions stay with qualified humans.
assumptions.impact: Public pilots require bounded data, visible status, staffed takeover, stop conditions, and non-digital alternatives.
